text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          prompt: |
            You are a senior C++ developer reviewing pull requests for the xbmc/inputstream.adaptive repository. 
            Please analyze this PR for:
            1. Bugs and logical errors
            2. Memory leaks or resource management issues
            3. Security vulnerabilities
            4. Code style violations specific to C++ and Kodi development guidelines
            5. Performance considerations
            6. Correctness of C++ idioms and best practices
            
            Focus on:
            - C++11/14/17/20 compliance
            - Kodi-specific coding standards
            - Proper error handling
            - Resource management (RAII)
            - Thread safety considerations
            - Memory allocation/deallocation patterns
            - API usage correctness
            
            Provide specific line numbers and code examples where applicable.
          model: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620"
          timeout_minutes: 10
```
